title: Fine-tuned ProGen generates antimicrobial peptides with confirmed activity
summary: ProGen, a decoder-only protein language model, was fine-tuned on known antimicrobial peptides to generate sequences, which were screened with an AMP classifier and filtered by predicted minimum inhibitory concentration and structural insight. Biological assays confirmed antimicrobial activity in all generated peptides that were tested, and fluorescence and circular dichroism characterized membrane binding and structure. Layer probing and attention analysis interpreted the model. The abstract does not give the number of peptides tested.
ai_technology: Fine-tuned ProGen protein language model, AMP classifier and interpretability analysis (layer probing, self-attention)
